Top five GitHub repositories whose main language is not Python, ordered by highest number of commits:

1. apple/swift (1,051 commits; main language: C++)
2. twbs/bootstrap (340 commits; main language: JavaScript)
3. Microsoft/vscode (190 commits; main language: TypeScript)
4. facebook/react (178 commits; main language: JavaScript)
5. tensorflow/tensorflow (156 commits; main language: C++)

Method: Counted commits per repository in artifacts_database.commits (6 repos total), then joined with metadata_database.languages to determine each repo's main language (the language with the largest byte share in the language description). All five repos with declared language metadata have a non-Python main language. torvalds/linux (16,061 commits) has the most commits but has no declared language entry in the metadata languages table, so its main language cannot be confirmed from the metadata and it is excluded from this list. (Artifact file data does suggest it is primarily C: 160 .c and 136 .h files, with no Python files.)
